tools.name: magnific_account_balance
tools.description: User plan + credits. Check before paid generations. Returns plan.{tier,productName,isUnlimitedMode}, credits.{available,totalPlan,spent,hasExtraCredits}. No history.

tools.name: magnific_creations_wait
tools.description: Long-poll 1..8 creations until terminal or `timeoutSeconds` (default 25, max 25). In-progress entries get `poll_after_seconds` for the next call.

tools.name: magnific_creations_get
tools.description: Single creation complete data — metadata + URLs (`url` full-res, `previewUrl` ~1024px, `thumbnailUrl` ~400px).

tools.name: magnific_creations_search
tools.description: Search user creations as raw TOON text. Use `creations_get` for one id. `reference` required with from=folder/project-root. Defaults: history, page 1.

tools.name: magnific_creations_list
tools.description: Filterable gallery widget (image/video/audio). Use instead of `creations_search` when user wants to browse their library.

tools.name: magnific_creations_request_upload
tools.description: Step 1 for local/user files: get presigned PUT URL(s). Upload bytes outside MCP, then call `creations_finalize_upload`.

tools.name: magnific_creations_finalize_upload
tools.description: Step 2 after PUT from `creations_request_upload`: convert temp path(s) to creations. Images <=25MB, videos <=200MB.

tools.name: magnific_creations_upload_image
tools.description: Upload public image URL in one step. For local/user files use `creations_request_upload` then `creations_finalize_upload`.

tools.name: magnific_creations_upload_file
tools.description: Import a file the user attached in the host (e.g. a ChatGPT upload) as a creation, then use the returned identifier in image tools. Use this instead of asking for a URL when the user already uploaded a local file. For a public URL use `creations_upload_image`.

tools.name: magnific_creations_move
tools.description: Move creations into `targetFolderReference`. Identifiers from `images_generate`/`creations_search`. Foreign identifier → abort. Target folder must belong to user.

tools.name: magnific_creations_like
tools.description: Toggle heart/favorite reaction on a user-owned creation.

tools.name: magnific_creations_comment
tools.description: Add a comment (or reply) to a user-owned creation.

tools.name: magnific_folders_list
tools.description: List folders/projects as raw TOON text. No params=top level; `onlyProjects`=projects; `parentReference`=children. Refs work with creations/folder tools.

tools.name: magnific_folders_get
tools.description: Fetch folder metadata by `reference`. Use before `creations_search` (`from=folder`). Foreign refs error.

tools.name: magnific_folders_create
tools.description: Create folder/project. No `parentReference`: workspace root. `type` defaults: project at root, folder when nested.

tools.name: magnific_folders_rename
tools.description: Rename a folder by `reference`.

tools.name: magnific_folders_delete
tools.description: Move a folder and its files to trash.

tools.name: magnific_project_report
tools.description: English markdown status report for a project/folder. Last 7 days default, max 30.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_list
tools.description: Lean spaces catalog as raw TOON text. Share each `webUrl`; call `spaces_show` only for inline canvas preview. Do not use `creations_search`.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_create
tools.description: Create empty Space. Share `space.webUrl`; only call `spaces_show` when inline preview is requested.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_state
tools.description: Read-only board context, raw TOON. Default: current page + pageIndex (other pages, counts). pageId: another page on demand. scope=all: whole board (costly). selectedElementIds: selected nodes. Needs view perm.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_get_nodes
tools.description: Read-only. Like `spaces_state` but scoped to `nodeIds` + their connections. Cheaper than full board. Needs view perm.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_run
tools.description: Run Space workflow from `startNodeId`. Modes: singular, connected default, downstream. Poll with `spaces_run_status`.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_run_status
tools.description: Poll `spaces_run`. `timeoutSeconds` long-polls up to 25s. In-progress returns `poll_after_seconds`; terminal call `creations_show`.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_edit
tools.description: External MCP only. Start headless Space edit. Poll `spaces_edit_status` until allTerminal, then verify with `spaces_state`.

tools.name: magnific_spaces_edit_status
tools.description: Wait for `spaces_edit` like `creations_wait`: long-polls up to `timeoutSeconds` (default 25, max 25). Snapshot-only when 0. Terminal → `spaces_state`.

tools.name: magnific_images_generate
tools.description: Generate/edit images. No refs=TTI. references[] (max 12; see field docs). Defaults: mode=auto, ratio=1:1, count<=8. resolution/quality per images_models_list. UI clients: after generating, MUST call `creations_show` with all identifiers; never stop at links.

tools.name: magnific_images_remove_background
tools.description: Cut-out subject on transparent PNG. Color BG: `images_color_background`. AI scene: `images_generate` with reference + prompt "replace the background with X".

tools.name: magnific_images_upscale
tools.description: AI upscale 2x/4x (Magnific, premium). Exact pixels: `images_resize`. Aspect: `images_crop`. Default scale=2.

tools.name: magnific_images_skin_enhancer
tools.description: AI skin enhancer. faithful preserves identity; creative reinterprets; flexible uses presets. Defaults: faithful, sharpen=0, smartGrain=0.

tools.name: magnific_images_relight
tools.description: AI relight. 1-4 lights with azimuth/elevation enums, type neutral|gel, intensity 1-10. Gel uses hex `color`.

tools.name: magnific_images_change_camera
tools.description: Reframe camera around subject. Defaults: rotate=45, vertical=0, closeup=5.

tools.name: magnific_images_variations
tools.description: Generate image-variation grid. Modes: angles|demographics|expressions|age|storyboard|custom. Defaults: angles, 3x3, 1:1, 4k.

tools.name: magnific_images_crop
tools.description: Center-crop to `aspectRatio`. Pixels: `images_resize`. AI upscale: `images_upscale`. Ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9.

tools.name: magnific_images_resize
tools.description: Resize to exact pixels (no AI). For real detail upscaling: `images_upscale` first. Aspect: `images_crop`. Dimensions snap to multiples of 8; center-crop on aspect mismatch.

tools.name: magnific_images_to_svg
tools.description: Trace raster creation into SVG. New vector from prompt: `images_generate_svg`.

tools.name: magnific_images_generate_svg
tools.description: Text-to-SVG (Recraft v4 Pro Vector). Raster: `images_generate`. Trace existing raster: `images_to_svg`. Default aspectRatio=1:1.

tools.name: magnific_images_models_list
tools.description: TTI model catalog as lean TOON text. `search` filters by name, slug, description, or tags.

tools.name: magnific_library_list
tools.description: Lean library catalog (characters, styles, elements, locations) for agent reasoning. Picker assets use library://.

tools.name: magnific_library_create
tools.description: Create a reusable library asset (character/product/location) from 1-6 images. Use the returned numeric `id` in generation refs (same id Spaces uses). No LoRA training.

tools.name: magnific_models3d_generate
tools.description: Image-to-3D GLB. Upload external images first. Animate with `models3d_rig`. Models: tripo-p1 default, tripo-v31, trellis-2.

tools.name: magnific_video_plan
tools.description: Call FIRST for any video request. Returns markdown plan: brief, open questions, characters to prepare, recommended model slug, prompt draft. Videos >15s: plan splits into clips + `video_concatenate` instructions.

tools.name: magnific_video_generate
tools.description: Generate video. External clients: call `video_plan` first to draft the brief and resolve model choice — skip only if the user explicitly says "just generate" or "one-shot". Pick a model with `slug` (copy it verbatim from `video_models_list`); omit `slug` for auto-select. Image refs: use an asset URL

tools.name: magnific_video_models_list
tools.description: Video-gen model catalog as lean TOON text. `search` filters by name, slug, description, or tags. Run `video_plan` first — plan resolves slug to validate here.

tools.name: magnific_video_upscale
tools.description: Upscale video via Topaz or Magnific. Pass `creationIdentifier` or Freepik `videoUrl`. Params: `video_upscale_models_list`. Then call `creations_show`.

tools.name: magnific_video_upscale_models_list
tools.description: Video upscale mode catalog as raw TOON text (topaz, magnific, magnific_precision) with required/optional params, ranges and enums. Read before calling `video_upscale`.

tools.name: magnific_video_concatenate
tools.description: Concatenate completed video creations into one MP4. Assembles multi-clip plans from `video_plan`. Audio from each clip; no external audio bed. Returns queued creation.

tools.name: magnific_video_speak
tools.description: Make a character speak. Image+audio → talking head (Veed Fabric 1.0). Video+audio → lip sync (Lipsync 2.0). Omit `mode` for auto. Pass asset URLs or a creation `identifier` (from `audio_tts`, `images_generate`, `video_generate`). Then call `creations_show`.

tools.name: magnific_audio_tts
tools.description: TTS voiceover. Single (voiceId) or 2-speaker (speakers). ElevenLabs/Google. No voiceId? Call `audio_voices_show` first (or `audio_voices_list` for agent-only lookup).

tools.name: magnific_audio_music_generate
tools.description: AI music generation. Google Lyria or ElevenLabs. Pass `prompt`, optional `model`/`durationSeconds`/`instrumental`. Lyria/Lyria-3 produce fixed 30s; Lyria-3-Pro accepts 30–180s; ElevenLabs accepts 10–300s.

tools.name: magnific_audio_voices_list
tools.description: TTS voice catalog as raw TOON text, no UI. Lean entries without preview URLs. Optional `search` filters by name, description, gender, or language.

tools.name: magnific_design_auto_resize
tools.description: Create resized design pages from an image. Use directly when ratios/social formats are known; otherwise show `design_auto_resize_show`.

tools.name: magnific_design_auto_layers
tools.description: Extract editable layers from a flat image into a Pikaso design.

tools.name: magnific_flows_list
tools.description: Flows catalog as raw TOON text, no UI. Lean entries without preview URLs. For an inline picker use flows_show; for a single flow input/output spec use flows_get.

tools.name: magnific_flows_get
tools.description: Flow input/output spec as raw TOON text. Each input includes a normalized `kind`, `howToProvide`, and resolved `options`/`presetOptions` where applicable. Call before `flows_run`.

tools.name: magnific_flows_run
tools.description: Run flow. `flows_get` first for input specs. `inputs` is `{inputId: value}` (creation inputs from `creations_list`, voices from `audio_voices_show`). Returns `workflowRunIdentifier` → `flows_wait` → `creations_show`.

tools.name: magnific_flows_wait
tools.description: Long-poll a `flows_run`. Terminal: one entry per output creation with real `identifier` for `creations_show`. In-progress: `poll_after_seconds`.

tools.name: magnific_stock_search
tools.description: Search Freepik stock catalog by keyword. Returns items with IDs, titles, types, preview URLs. Use stock_get for full details, stock_download for file URL.

tools.name: magnific_stock_get
tools.description:
Full details for a single Freepik stock item: preview URL, dimensions, formats, author.

Bulk support: accepts ids for batched execution.

tools.name: magnific_stock_download
tools.description:
Signed download URL for a stock item. Pass folder_reference to also save as a creation (rate-limited).

Bulk support: accepts ids for batched execution.

tools.name: magnific_stock_to_creation
tools.description:
Convert Freepik stock item → Pikaso creation. Use after user selects from stock_show.

Bulk support: accepts ids for batched execution.

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.

tools.name: marketplace
tools.description: The official mcp.ai marketplace — the in-platform catalog of every MCP/tool, AND the way to run them. Covers capability requests like "find an MCP that does X", "consulta um CPF", "is there a tool for Y". Core flow: action=search discovers MCPs by intent → describe returns one MCP's full profile (ev

tools.description: MCP.AI for IDE agents (Cursor, etc.): log in in the browser, copy the access token. Best: add it to this server's config as a header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for a permanent, non-expiring connection. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_magnific" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: magnific_creations_get, magnific_creations_request_upload, magnific_audio_voices_list, magnific_flows_list, magnific_stock_search, magnific_stock_get · Private data: magnific_creations_request_upload, magnific_creations_upload_image, magnific_creations_upload_file, magnific_folders_delete, magnific_stock_search, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: magnific_creations_request_upload, magnific_creations_finalize_upload, magnific_creations_upload_image, magnific_creations_upload_file, magnific_spaces_list, magnific_spaces_create, magnific_models3d_generate, report_bug · Destructive: magnific_folders_delete, magnific_spaces_run, magnific_spaces_run_status, magnific_images_remove_background, magnific_video_models_list, magnific_flows_run, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: magnific_creations_get, magnific_creations_request_upload, magnific_audio_voices_list, magnific_flows_list, magnific_stock_search, magnific_stock_get · Private data: magnific_creations_request_upload, magnific_creations_upload_image, magnific_creations_upload_file, magnific_folders_delete, magnific_stock_search, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: magnific_creations_request_upload, magnific_creations_finalize_upload, magnific_creations_upload_image, magnific_creations_upload_file, magnific_spaces_list, magnific_spaces_create, magnific_models3d_generate, report_bug · Destructive: magnific_folders_delete, magnific_spaces_run, magnific_spaces_run_status, magnific_images_remove_background, magnific_video_models_list, magnific_flows_run, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
